about.title: About Pro Care
about.lead: Pro Care Trading Contracting and Facility Services is a Qatar-licensed operator running five disciplines under one roof — so the handover from build to clean to maintain happens without a sub-contract chain.
about.story: Founded in Doha and registered under Commercial Registry 217949, Pro Care is built around a simple thesis: most Qatar projects lose weeks at the seams between contractors. By holding licenses across construction (410029), post-construction cleaning (433091), building materials retail (475281), facility maintenance (811003) and pest control (812904), we collapse those seams into a single accountable team.

values.title: Single point of accountability
values.body: One project lead from kick-off to year-three FM. No sub-contract finger-pointing.

values.title: Bilingual delivery
values.body: Every site report, drawing markup and SLA review issued in English and Arabic.

values.title: Documented handover
values.body: Every project closes with a signed handover pack — drawings, warranties, MSDS, contact tree.

values.title: Local sourcing
values.body: Materials sourced through our retail license keep margin and lead-time inside the country.
